name: toeic-monster
description: toeic.monster — 발음·예문으로 외우는 TOEIC 필수 어휘 1,000 정적 사이트

scripts.audit: npm run audit:content && npm run audit:text && npm run audit:site && npm run audit:a11y && npm run audit:density
scripts.test: node tools/test-home-ux.mjs && node tools/test-tts-voice.mjs && node tools/test-grammar-quiz.mjs && node tools/test-conversation-quiz.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:pages && npm run prerender
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run audit && npm run test
scripts.check:ci: npm run check && npm run verify
